Hello! I'd like to request art of my character Alula: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mu0VGwWF2yWqz5XO0YXULXj5ocuwlX43/view?usp=drivesdk

She usually appears as a charming wanderer just passing through. She has the ability to walk between worlds like there's an invisible road connecting them, so she picks one and goes among the people. She is genuinely open and friendly to people, but she can seem shy, and there's an air of mystery and sadness to her at times. She's grateful for company and people opening their hearts to her, but she never stays in one place for too long.

I'm happy to leave the details of the art up to you. If it helps, she likes collecting umbrellas from the worlds she visits (if you include that, the design is up to you). Just something that reflects her personality will be nice.

I look forward to seeing what you do!
